Null if the Voucher wasn't activated

start_date.description:
Start Date of the Subscription created from the Voucher.
Null if the Voucher wasn't activated

end_date.description:
End Date of the Subscription created from the Voucher.
Null if the Voucher wasn't activated (or if Subscription is endless)

features.description: A list of Features attached to the Voucher
